proof:
Source: Step 4 (definition of the forcing Phi_d) and Step 5 (H4) of the parent proof.
1. Definition. G(x) := integral_0^1 g(x + (td)e) dt in R^l (an interval integral, defined for every x). Phi(x) is the composition of the continuous linear map P -> Pe (evaluation at e, L -> R^l; ContinuousLinearMap.apply) with the continuous linear form v -> <G(x), v> (innerSL). So Phi(x) is a continuous linear form on L and Phi(x)[P] = <G(x), Pe> for all x and P.
2. g is continuous on K: for p, q in K, ||g(q) - g(p)|| <= H||q - p||^alpha <= max(H, 0)||q - p||^alpha, and max(H, 0)||q - p||^alpha -> 0 as q -> p because alpha > 0 (continuity of r -> r^alpha at 0, where it vanishes).
3. For x in S, t -> x + (td)e is continuous and maps [0,1] into K, so t -> g(x + (td)e) is continuous on [0,1] and therefore interval integrable on [0,1].
4. For x, y in S and t in [0,1], both x + (td)e and y + (td)e lie in K and their difference is x - y, so ||g(x + (td)e) - g(y + (td)e)|| <= H||x - y||^alpha. By step 3, G(x) - G(y) = integral_0^1 (g(x + (td)e) - g(y + (td)e)) dt (intervalIntegral.integral_sub), and the constant bound on (0,1] gives ||G(x) - G(y)|| <= H||x - y||^alpha |1 - 0| = H||x - y||^alpha (intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const).
5. For x, y in S and P in L: Phi(x)[P] - Phi(y)[P] = <G(x) - G(y), Pe> (inner_sub_left). By Cauchy-Schwarz and ||Pe|| <= ||P|| ||e||, |Phi(x)[P] - Phi(y)[P]| <= ||G(x) - G(y)|| ||P|| ||e|| <= H||x - y||^alpha ||P|| ||e|| = H||e|| ||x - y||^alpha ||P||, multiplying the inequality of step 4 by ||P|| ||e|| >= 0. QED

theorem Submission.dohr_eb_elc2_averaged_forcing : ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (α H d : ℝ) (g : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (S K : Set (Rn n)) (e : Rn n), 0 < α → (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, x + (t * d) • e ∈ K) → (∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ‖g x - g y‖ ≤ H * ‖x - y‖ ^ α) → ∃ Φ : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ, (∀ (x : Rn n) (P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ), Φ x P = inner ℝ (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, g (x + (t * d) • e)) (P e)) ∧ ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, ∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |Φ x P - Φ y P| ≤ H * ‖e‖ * ‖x - y‖ ^ α * ‖P‖ := by
  intro n ℓ α H d g S K e hα hseg hH
  set G : Rn n → Rn ℓ := fun x => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, g (x + (t * d) • e) with hG
  refine ⟨fun x => (innerSL ℝ (G x)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ (Rn ℓ) e), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x P
    simp [G, innerSL_apply_apply]
  · -- continuity of g on K
    have hgc : ContinuousOn g K := by
      intro p hp
      rw [Metric.continuousWithinAt_iff]
      intro η hη
      -- choose δ with max H 0 * δ^α < η
      have hcont : Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => max H 0 * r ^ α) (𝓝[≥] 0) (𝓝 (max H 0 * 0 ^ α)) := by
        apply Tendsto.const_mul
        exact ((Real.continuousAt_rpow_const 0 α (Or.inr hα.le)).tendsto).mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
      rw [Real.zero_rpow hα.ne', mul_zero] at hcont
      obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδη⟩ := (Metric.tendsto_nhdsWithin_nhds.mp hcont) η hη
      refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun q hq hqp => ?_⟩
      rw [dist_eq_norm] at hqp ⊢
      have h1 := hH q hq p hp
      have h2 : max H 0 * ‖q - p‖ ^ α < η := by
        have := hδη (x := ‖q - p‖) (by simp) (by simpa [Real.dist_eq, abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)] using hqp)
        rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero] at this
        exact lt_of_le_of_lt (le_abs_self _) this
      calc ‖g q - g p‖ ≤ H * ‖q - p‖ ^ α := h1
        _ ≤ max H 0 * ‖q - p‖ ^ α := by gcongr; exact le_max_left _ _
        _ < η := h2
    have hint : ∀ x ∈ S, IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ => g (x + (t * d) • e)) volume 0 1 := by
      intro x hx
      apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
      rw [uIcc_of_le zero_le_one]
      refine hgc.comp (by fun_prop) (fun t ht => hseg x hx t ht)
    intro x hx y hy P
    have hGd : ‖G x - G y‖ ≤ H * ‖x - y‖ ^ α := by
      simp only [G]
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hint x hx) (hint y hy)]
      have := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := 0) (b := 1)
        (C := H * ‖x - y‖ ^ α) (f := fun t => g (x + (t * d) • e) - g (y + (t * d) • e)) (by
          intro t ht
          rw [uIoc_of_le zero_le_one] at ht
          have h := hH _ (hseg x hx t ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2⟩) _ (hseg y hy t ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2⟩)
          simpa using h)
      simpa using this
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.apply_apply, innerSL_apply_apply]
    rw [← inner_sub_left]
    calc |inner ℝ (G x - G y) (P e)| ≤ ‖G x - G y‖ * ‖P e‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
      _ ≤ ‖G x - G y‖ * (‖P‖ * ‖e‖) := by gcongr; exact P.le_opNorm e
      _ ≤ (H * ‖x - y‖ ^ α) * (‖P‖ * ‖e‖) := by gcongr
      _ = H * ‖e‖ * ‖x - y‖ ^ α * ‖P‖ := by ring
